pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If A's restatement is a loose paraphrase produced without direct textual dependence on B (i.e. both independently re-derive the same T/Q/Pi formalism from a shared deeper source), EXTENSION would overstate direct lineage; the phrase 'naming it the foundation... already covered extensively... in this batch' argues for genuine incorporation rather than independent re-derivation.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Which sharpens V1 rather than weakening it: the zero-algebra estate itself runs on at least two record types -- Item(token, source, uncertainty, scope, polarity, node, edge_to) and Rec(v, s, t, rank). Recorded for Governance. Theory 13 is not modified, and I do not call it an error.
rationale_evidence.statement: Argues the self-correction actually strengthens (not weakens) V1's finding: the estate demonstrably runs on at least two distinct record-carrier types (a 7-field Item and a 4-field Rec) across different experiments, recorded as a governance-relevant observation without modifying Theory 13 or calling it an error.
